title: Code for: A Two-Stage Plasma Biomarker Algorithm Reduces Amyloid PET Use and the p-Tau217 Gray Zone
description: GRAD (Gatekeeper-Reflex for Alzheimer's Diagnostics) is a two-stage plasma biomarker algorithm that resolves the indeterminate p-tau217 gray zone and reserves amyloid PET for residual uncertainty. Stage 1 is a univariate logistic regression on reference-anchored p-tau217 that routes cases with predicted probability between 0.25 and 0.75 forward. Stage 2 is an L2-regularized logistic regression (C = 0.1, balanced class weights) scoring those cases on seven plasma, genetic and demographic features. The model was developed in 145 cognitively impaired ADNI participants under leave-one-out cross-validation and validated without refitting in 1,644 cognitively unimpaired A4 and LEARN participants. This release contains the analysis pipeline, figure and supplementary-table generation, and the reference-anchoring sensitivity analysis. Superseded random-forest code from the earlier design is retained under archive/ for provenance.
